Through the development of reporting frameworks, dashboards, visualisations, and analytical models, the Data Analyst provides actionable recommendations that drive performance, identify trends, improve efficiency, and support organisational objectives.   The Data Analyst ensures that data is managed ethically, securely, and in accordance with organisational governance frameworks, privacy obligations, and regulatory requirements.    Benefits   Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding organisation.    Opportunity to influence strategic business decisions.    Collaborative and emerging trends and provide recommendations based on evidence and data-driven insights.   Translate complex data into practical recommendations for operational and executive teams.     Reporting & Visualisation     Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualisations that provide meaningful business insights.   Produce regular operational, financial, workforce, forecasting, budgeting, and organisational performance reviews.     Systems, Automation & Development     Utilise analytical tools and technologies to improve reporting efficiency and organisational visibility.   Develop automated reporting solutions where appropriate to reduce manual processing and improve accuracy.   Write, maintain, and optimise scripts, queries, and code to support data extraction, transformation, analysis, and reporting activities.   Work collaboratively with internal technology teams to enhance reporting capabilities and system integrations.   Support the development of data models and business intelligence solutions.   Identify opportunities to leverage technology and automation to improve organisational performance and decision-making.     Stakeholder Engagement     Partner with department leaders to understand reporting requirements and business challenges.   Provide guidance and support to staff regarding data interpretation and reporting outputs.   Build strong working relationships across all departments to ensure data is utilised effectively.   Facilitate data-informed decision-making by providing accurate, reliable, and actionable insights.   Support organisational projects through the provision of analytical expertise and reporting requirements.     Compliance, Risk & Quality     Ensure all data handling activities comply with privacy, confidentiality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.   Maintain appropriate controls to safeguard organisational and participant information.   Identify and escalate risks relating to data quality, integrity, security, or governance.   Support internal audits, external audits, accreditation requirements, and compliance reporting activities.   Contribute to continuous
